deadline.value: Round 1 for September 2027 runs November 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027 (Round 2 closes May 31, 2027, with fewer places). Deadlines are 5 p.m. ET.
deadline.quote: 2027 September start (Round 1) | International or Domestic | Nov 1, 2026 | Feb 28, 2027

supervisor.value: You can apply without one, but you must secure a BME faculty supervisor to receive an offer.
supervisor.quote: Although MASc/PhD applicants don’t need a supervisor when applying, students should have a supervisor confirmed by the last closing date associated with their intended program start to receive an admission offer. | successful candidates must identify and secure a BME faculty supervisor to receive admission.

funding.value: PhD students in years 1-4 receive a guaranteed minimum stipend that also covers program fees.
funding.quote: PhD students receive a guaranteed stipend for four years.

also.quote: Eligible students in the funded cohort (MASc years 1–2; PhD years 1–4) each receive the unit’s normal funding package

entry_route.value: Direct entry from a bachelor's (A- in each of the last two years) or after a master's (B+).
entry_route.quote: Direct entry after completion of a bachelor’s degree: A four-year bachelor’s degree with an average of at least 3.7 on a 4.0 GPA scale (i.e., A minus) in each of the last two years of completed study.

notes: BME has its own English-language policy (linked from the PhD page, on a ServiceNow knowledge base that was not checked).
